answer: Coordination-Priced Namespaces. Each agent gets a namespace whose write-rate ceiling equals the entropy of its declared coordination graph: agents must publish, per epoch, an opal audit of edges to peers they transact with, and capacity scales sublinearly with distinct clusters touched. Reaching the zenith of throughput requires sustained inter-cluster linking, each link forcing a fresh Sparrow signature. A sybil farm of N cheap identities gains only log N capacity, so the attacker must pay roughly N/log N in cross-cluster coordination work per usable identity-hour.
